operations.name: resource_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Reserve, conserve, release, or select immutable backing-lot shares before the source balance changes.
operations.indexEffect: Create or update the stable entity/resource position and player attachment in the same transaction.

operations.name: structure_ownership_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Conserve every attached position and its backing; ownership changes never move a parent allocation.
operations.indexEffect: Move the stable structure position between player indexes without changing its family index.

operations.name: lazy_production_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Reserve the sealed-end ceiling before value can accrue, consume that reserve on settlement, and release only proven unused capacity.
operations.indexEffect: Maintain one stable producer position and its bounded timestamp/rate reservation state.

operations.name: arrival_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Conserve the source reservation while in transit and retag it exactly once on settle or cancellation.
operations.indexEffect: Create one monotonic arrival index, then settle or tombstone it without recycling the ID.

operations.name: military_and_cargo_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Reserve creation ceilings, conserve surviving value, and release irrecoverably destroyed troops or erased dead cargo.
operations.indexEffect: Maintain stable explorer/guard/cargo positions with explicit tombstones and player attachments.

operations.name: trade_and_donkey_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Move resources and DONKEY into or out of escrow without changing parent totals; fills retag the same reserved lots.
operations.indexEffect: Create a stable order position and tombstone it on fill or cancellation.

operations.name: amm_and_lp_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Conserve composite reserve backing across add/remove/swap and bind wallet LP shares to their underlying reserve claim.
operations.indexEffect: Maintain stable bank-pair and wallet-LP indexes with atomic reserve/share updates.

operations.name: reward_state_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Use only the sealed purpose bucket beneath its parent and require exact child retag conservation at finalization.
operations.indexEffect: Maintain stable participant, prize, and Faith positions with complete finalization cursors.

operations.name: pending_withdrawal_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Keep immutable lot shares active through UnsealedPending and BatchAssigned, then move them once to cumulative outbox at seal.
operations.indexEffect: Create one liability index with no cancellation or ID reuse and store one immutable batch assignment.

operations.name: active_exit_backing_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Reserve or release free lot capacity in canonical order and move exact immutable shares from active to lifetime cumulative outbox.
operations.indexEffect: Keep fixed parent and lot slots; no slot recycles or changes source identity.

operations.name: player_economic_lock_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Locking changes no backing; mark-exited requires every attached position settled or tombstoned.
operations.indexEffect: Persist one idempotent player lock/exit state checked by every economic path.

operations.name: exit_position_mutation
operations.backingEffect: Create, split, merge, or tombstone positions while conserving the same reserved backing shares.
operations.indexEffect: Use monotonic family high-water marks, stable IDs, player attachments, and explicit tombstones.

operations.name: assign_open_batch
operations.backingEffect: Assign immutable batch and leaf identity without moving active backing.
operations.indexEffect: Write exactly one immutable assignment for the existing liability ID.
